**Verdict: PASS. I'm raising no new findings, so `findings` is `[]` and there's no sidecar file.**

**Candidate:** `sha256:dfedd62f…689ed3` (757 files, source `21e2742`). It matched in the repository at the start and the end, at `--ref`, and in a complete clone. HEAD moved during my run (other reviewers' evidence plus an orchestrator assignment), but only files under `docs/delivery/` changed. I didn't read any other reviewer's round-5 record.

**Round-5 repair (T-DG3-KBE-G), tested from the acceptance side:**
- **Lint and source scan:** I added 17 forbidden handler forms (W1, W2, W4, W5 and other variants) to both `parse.ts` and `value.ts`. Lint and the scan refused every one and accepted the allowed shape. After I restored the files, lint was clean.
- **Run time:** I injected real code generation at each of the 4 catch sites, including the new `parseFormula` one. In every case the no-codegen run failed with EvalError, and the error was never turned into an "internal" problem.
- **Unchanged behaviour:** the formula API still answers 422 with each formula's own error code (never 500), `formatDecimal` still shows Unknown for invalid values, and `pnpm test` runs both Vitest invocations.

**Full regression:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Static checks (7) | all exit 0; OpenAPI has 270 operations |
| Unit tests: Node 22 and 24, locale unset and C.UTF-8 | 1614/1614, then 220 passed + 1 skip |
| Integration, run twice | 793/793 each time; migrations 0001→0027 applied; every pending list empty |
| e2e, chromium-en and chromium-ar, both locale settings | 216 passed per setting, the same as round 4 spec by spec; 0 axe violations; the auditor read-only pass is clean |
| F180 layout probe | 7/7 badges inside, so F-DG3-180 still holds (no verifications file written) |
| Validators (register, pipeline, historical DG2 and DG1) | PASS at both the start and the end |
| Acceptance texts | all 32 pass as written |

**Every non-zero exit is explained (none is a finding):**
- **Probe failures:** the static and mutation probes are meant to exit 1.
- **e2e:** each e2e run exits 1 because of the 2 F180b failures, one per browser project. In the 390 px + 200% text state the gate grid, unchanged since DG2, is wider than the viewport. This is the same observation as in rounds 3 and 4.
- **Skipped unit test:** the 1 skip is deliberate: a lint-config test that can't run without code generation. It runs and passes in the first invocation.
- **Redone edge probe:** my first edge probe was inconclusive because its thrower fired every time. I re-ran it correctly and kept both logs.

**Observations, not findings:**
- **Static gaps:** three forms get past lint and the scan: a `finally` that throws while an error is in flight, a `using` block whose dispose throws, and a generator `finally`. ADR-0024 §6 already describes those static checks as best effort. The run-time check still catches all three on tested paths (24, 5, 73 and 104 failed tests).
- **Spec location:** the assignment says to copy the specs into `tests/round-3/`. That folder holds my round-3 evidence, which must not be changed, so the copy is in `tests/round-5/`. It differs from round 4's spec only in 6 renamed lines.

**Environmental residuals** (live registry D-057, live CI D-058, Keycloak D-049) are recorded as PASS on the offline/config surface, with the residual noted.

**Housekeeping:**
- **Scratch scripts:** a safety check blocked my final `rm` of the leftover helper scripts in this run's `$TMPDIR`, and I didn't retry it. The clones themselves were already deleted, and the runner removes that directory when the run ends.
- **Missing records:** `git status` shows the other reviewers' round-5 records as missing in my sandboxed view. That's expected, because their records aren't visible during my run. I didn't delete anything.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG3/round-5/`:
- qa-verifier.json (validated against the review schema; all 82 evidence paths exist)
- qa-verifier.md

The evidence is under `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG3/qa/round-5/`, starting with RUN-NOTES.md.
